title: Decide how much evidence a system change needs
description: Select a change to the validated system boundary, then strengthen independent evidence and containment. The result is an engineering posture, not regulatory approval.

scenarios.label: New acquisition device
scenarios.detail: A site introduces a device or software version absent from the validation evidence.
requiredEvidence: Verify the transformed input contract and acquisition quality.
Compare paired or independently reviewed performance across device slices.
Test rejection and fallback behavior for unsupported versions.

scenarios.label: EHR mapping change
scenarios.detail: A code, unit, default, or timestamp mapping changes without changing model weights.
requiredEvidence: Diff old and new semantic mappings with representative records.
Replay contract checks and compare score distributions by site.
Prove that rollback restores the prior mapping and queued work.

scenarios.label: Population expansion
scenarios.detail: The workflow proposes use in a demographic, care setting, or severity band not covered by the original claim.
requiredEvidence: Define the new population and clinically relevant outcome reference.
Evaluate calibration and error consequences in the new and original slices.
Review usability, access, and equity impacts with affected stakeholders.

scenarios.label: Interface and alert change
scenarios.detail: The score is unchanged, but presentation, ranking, or alert routing changes user behavior.
requiredEvidence: Test comprehension, disagreement, override, and time-to-action.
Measure alert volume and workload under realistic traffic.
Preserve the prior interface as a tested fallback.
